decisions.reason: It supports the firm's move toward digital document workflows and, after several years of learning, is likely to meet aspiration levels well enough to retain.

Even though it uses existing email and fax capabilities, by 2022 this legacy conversion service is more likely to fall below rising aspirations in a growing cloud market, so resources are better shifted elsewhere.
As a close-to-core fax optimization feature with relatively low incremental resource demands, it is still worth carrying for existing customer needs unless results worsen clearly.
Security protection fits the firm's core promise of secure and compliant communications and is likely to compare favorably with both past and peer aspiration levels.
